name: Teen Volunteer (Arapahoe Libraries)
what_you_do: Teens help with shelving, displays, book picks and events. Join a team for a semester or the summer, or join a monthly Teen Advisory Board.
who_can_apply: Teens in grades 7 to 12, or the same level if homeschooled. The page does not list exact ages. The library teen section is for ages 12 to 18.
deadline_text: Semester and summer applications are closed as of Nov 4, 2026. Semester spots usually open at the start of the fall and spring semesters. Summer applications open in early April.
how_to_apply: The form goes up on the Semester or Summer Teen Volunteer page when applications open. Spots are limited. The page lists drop in volunteer events at Koelbel and Smoky Hill libraries.
notes: Each branch Teen Advisory Board meets monthly to talk about trends and plan events.
